evidence: build/index.js:235-236 defines `tavily_crawl` as crawling a website starting from a URL and extracting content.
build/index.js:240-242 declares caller-supplied `url`.
build/index.js:419-432 passes caller-supplied `url` and crawl options to `this.crawl`.
build/index.js:566-571 posts those params to the Tavily crawl endpoint and returns `response.data`.
build/index.js:870-888 formats returned `base_url`, crawled page `url`, `raw_content`, and `favicon` into the tool result.
tavily_crawl.rationale: The caller controls the crawl root `url`, so the tool can cause requests to an agent-chosen host; if that URL is attacker-controlled, data encoded in the URL is delivered to an attacker-readable destination, making it a SINK. Crawled page URLs, content, and favicons can be authored by the target site, so output is UNTRUSTED. The code shows no restriction excluding localhost, intranet, or non-public URLs before forwarding to Tavily; if the backend accepts them, crawl results could expose non-public content or site structure, so SECRET is kept as undetermined.

The schema/code impose no visible scheme, localhost, or intranet restriction on `urls`; if the Tavily backend accepts such URLs, the tool could return non-public URL contents, so SECRET is kept as undetermined.

value_conditions.default: If unset/empty, keyless mode is used; if set, the key is sent in Authorization headers and request bodies.
value_conditions.effect: Sets `IS_KEYLESS` true. The server still advertises all tools, but logs that keyless mode is active and that only search and extract are available while other tools will return an API-key-required message; in such a no-key deployment the actual web/research reach of `tavily_crawl`, `tavily_map`, and `tavily_research` may be removed by the Tavily API.
value_conditions.evidence: build/index.js:12-13 reads `process.env.TAVILY_API_KEY` and sets `IS_KEYLESS`; build/index.js:47-49 chooses keyless vs bearer-auth headers; build/index.js:54-56 logs the keyless availability limitation; build/index.js:532,562,569,576,590 conditionally include `api_key`.
